text: 天数智芯(09903.HK)公告，预期本集团于2026年6月30日止六个月内将录得净利润约人民币6000万元至人民币1.4亿元，而截至2025年6月30日止六个月则录得净亏损约人民币6.093亿元。董事会认为，本集团于报告期间之业绩扭亏为盈，主要归因于报告期间内按公允价值计入损益的金融资产的公允价值收益介乎约人民币7.3亿元至人民币7.9亿元，其主要由于本集团于一间上海证券交易所上市公司之股份投资产生之未变现净收益大幅增加。
text_en: Tianshu Zhixin (09903.HK) announced that it expects to record a net profit of approximately RMB 60 million to RMB 140 million for the six months ended June 30, 2026, compared with a net loss of approximately RMB 609.3 million for the six months ended June 30, 2025. The board believes the turnaround to profitability in the reporting period is mainly due to fair value gains on financial assets measured at fair value through profit or loss, ranging from approximately RMB 730 million to RMB 790 million, primarily driven by a significant increase in unrealized net gains from the group's equity investment in a Shanghai Stock Exchange-listed company.
